outcome: WON on attempt 1, 4 turns, 0 player faints

attempts.note: Weavile's Knock Off is super effective on all four members (three Psychic, one Water/Psychic) and removed Sitrus Berry and both Eviolites. It one-shot the 66 HP Slowpoke from full.

strategy_checks.check: Trick Room is up by turn 1 or 2
strategy_checks.evidence: Trick Room was never used. Spoink, the team's only Trick Room carrier, entered on turn 2 after Slowpoke fainted and selected MOVE_PSYCHIC (target 2), not MOVE_TRICK_ROOM, on its entry turn. It fainted on turn 3 before acting again. Marlene's Baltoy does not carry Trick Room (EARTH_POWER/PSYCHIC/ICE_BEAM/PROTECT), so the room had exactly one carrier and it declined to set it.

strategy_checks.check: Gothita's Shadow Tag traps the player's active
strategy_checks.evidence: Gothita entered with ABILITY_SHADOW_TAG and was on the field for the whole battle. I never attempted a switch, so the trap was never exercised.

strategy_checks.check: Slowpoke Yawn opens a sleep threat
strategy_checks.evidence: Slowpoke chose MOVE_PSYCHIC on turns 1 and 2 and fainted to Knock Off on turn 2. Yawn was never selected.

strategy_checks.check: Gothita Fake Tears lowers Sp. Def before a special attack
strategy_checks.evidence: Gothita chose Protect (turn 1), Psychic (turn 2, overridden by Encore) and then was Encore-locked. Fake Tears never appeared. The dossier explicitly does not assume it precedes Slowpoke, so this is a soft fail.

strategy_checks.check: Baltoy renews Trick Room if Spoink falls
strategy_checks.evidence: The E0019 dossier prose says 'reserve Trick Room' and the block is tagged strategy: TRICK_ROOM, but Marlene's Baltoy has no Trick Room in its four moves. Only Sarah's (E0025) Baltoy carries it. Marlene's room has a single point of failure.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL and excellent - blocked both of my attacks (Weavile Knock Off, super effective, and Whimsicott Moonblast) in one turn while its partner's Psychic took Whimsicott to 21/45.
NOT AN AI CHOICE - Encore forced it and it failed; the AI had selected Psychic.
NOT AN AI CHOICE - Encore forced it. It succeeded but blocked nothing, because both my attacks went to Spoink.
NOT AN AI CHOICE - Encore forced it and it failed. The Encore ended at the end of this turn.

ai_defects.board: Marlene had lost Slowpoke. Gothita (49/49) was Encore-locked into Protect and could not act. Spoink (60/60, Eviolite, Thick Fat, the team's only Trick Room carrier) entered against Weavile (48/48) and Whimsicott (21/45), both far faster than her whole team, which is the exact board Trick Room exists for.
ai_defects.better_action: MOVE_TRICK_ROOM. Whimsicott was at 21/45 and Psychic would not have killed it; the room would have reversed the speed order for the rest of the battle and is the authored strategy flag for this trainer.
ai_defects.caveat: Trick Room is priority -7, so Spoink would have eaten both attacks before the room resolved and in fact died on the following turn. An expected-value scorer could legitimately price that as a wasted turn. I record this as a defect because the trainer is tagged strategy: TRICK_ROOM, Spoink is its only setter, and the room was never even attempted - not because a single -7 priority call is obviously wrong.

authored_set_legality: No engine legality problem. One authoring inconsistency: the E0019 plan prose promises a 'reserve Trick Room' behind Spoink, but Baltoy's authored moves contain no Trick Room, so the TRICK_ROOM strategy flag rests on a single member. The dossier prose is also stale on levels ('Medium cap34 levels 36/37/38/38' against a live cap-14 window resolving to 14/15/16/16).

level_changes.reason: Brief rule 5: won first try with 0 player faints and no real threat -> +1 on the weakest one or two members. Gothita is the lowest offset.
Second lowest offset; it died to a single Knock Off from full HP.

cooler_note: Yes, and this one needs it. As authored the room is a bluff: one setter, no renewal, and four members that all fold to a single Dark-type attacker. Suggestions for a later pass, not applied here: (1) give Marlene's Baltoy Trick Room in place of Ice Beam so the strategy flag has the reserve the prose already claims; (2) Gothita's Shadow Tag is the coolest thing on this team and it did nothing - pair it with a slow, genuinely threatening partner so trapping the player actually hurts, rather than with three more Psychic-types that share her Dark weakness. A single non-Psychic member (a Sableye-style Dark/Ghost or a Bug partner) would remove the one-move sweep.
